description:
A versatile mind mapping tool for collaborative brainstorming.

EdrawMind is designed for creating fresh new visual innovations, integrating your bullet points to structure an overall mind map. It is convenient and helpful for you to use EdrawMind to sort out your thoughts or ideas in order to find solutions to problems.
1. AI Export: Turn Mind Maps into Explainer Videos with One Click!
Function entry: Open a Mind Map, click 'Export' in the top right, and select 'AI Explainer Video'
Create with One Click: Click to generate, choose a style, and turn your Mind Map into a dynamic explainer video.
Voice Selection: Automatically detects mind map layers and text to generate natural, fluent storyboards and commentary audio, with multiple voices available.
Try now, experience an unprecedented way to express knowledge!
2. AI Export: Infographic/Knowledge Card
Function entry: Open a Mind Map, click "Export" in the top right, select "Infographic/Knowledge Card"
Say goodbye to layout headaches, and turn structured Mind Maps into beautiful, professional Infographic/Knowledge Card posters with one click.
Multiple style presets to choose from! Generate designer-level, premium-quality images with one click.
3. AI Export: Export Hand-drawn Mind Map
The export interface has been upgraded with [AI Export], which uses AI to turn your Mind Map into a Hand-drawn Mind Map with one click!
Function entry: After editing the Mind Map, click the top-right [Export - AI Export - Hand-drawn Mind Map];
(1) Method 1: Convert to hand-drawn format and generate a hand-drawn Mind Map file suitable for further editing;
(2) Mode 2: Generate hand-drawn mind map images directly with large image-model capabilities, suitable for direct delivery.
4. All-New AI Creation Home - EdrawMind AI
(1) Refreshed homepage UI and AI creation entry points. Mind maps, slides, file summaries, and more have now been centralized — start creating from the moment you open the homepage.
(2) Added token usage details and attachment upload guidance — supported formats, file size limits, and token costs are now clearly displayed for a worry-free experience.
(3) AI chat history inputs can now be copied with one click or brought back to the input box for re-editing, making it easier to reuse frequently used prompts.
5. Hand-drawn Map: New 'Explanation' Mode
Function entry: Open the Hand-drawn Map file, click the "Explain" button in the top right
Create explainer videos with one click. AI automatically generates narration scripts, voiceover, and subtitles, and combines node-traversal lens animations for quick sharing of mind-map ideas.
Supports manual, node-by-node walkthroughs with auto-focus to show mind map content.
